examples.name: Level of detail
examples.claim: A bounded level-of-detail scenario uses the capacity-bounded rooted-frontier composition and agrees with a separate exhaustive result.
limits: Rendering engine integration, visibility, streaming, hysteresis, and performance are excluded.
The result is bounded to finite quality ladders and byte budgets.

examples.name: LOD/quality scaling
examples.claim: The LOD quality-scaling reconstruction crosses every declared structural seam and agrees with its domain reference.
limits: This entry covers assembly and executable checks rather than a rendering product.

examples.name: Bounded OSPFv2 intra-area route selection
examples.claim: For normalized finite link-state inputs, conventional Dijkstra and rooted-frontier selection compute the same route costs and equal-cost next-hop sets as a separate Bellman-Ford reference.
limits: This is not an OSPF protocol implementation.
Input is a normalized directed topology rather than live LSAs.
Inter-area routing, external routing, flooding, aging, authentication, and convergence are excluded.
The rooted-frontier path enumerates finite simple paths and makes no routing-performance claim.

examples.name: LOD/OSPF structural correspondence
examples.claim: Both examples invoke QualityHierarchy, TraversalEngine, CompetitiveSelection, and AllocationSnapshot in the same rooted-frontier order after domain payload erasure.
limits: Budget<Bytes> is specific to LOD; OSPF has no route-slot budget.
Candidate generation and candidate measures remain domain-specific.
RelationshipGraph, ResourceRegistry, and path Reduction remain specific to the route example.
The relation does not equate view utility with path cost or routing semantics.

examples.name: Pipeline DAG
examples.claim: A bounded CI job-dependency DAG uses RelationshipGraph, TraversalEngine, and StepGraph, and its accepted schedules agree with an independent dependency enumerator.
limits: The evidence covers one immutable successful four-job workflow.
Conditional jobs, failures, retries, cancellation, product conformance, arbitrary graphs, and performance are excluded.

examples.name: Parallel test execution
examples.claim: A bounded complete test matrix uses ResourceRegistry, Budget<Compute>, and ForkJoin; every declared partition appears in the joined output and accepted schedules agree with an independent enumerator.
limits: The evidence covers two required test partitions inside the registered successful workflow.
The compute Budget is a total-work bound, not a runner-pool or wall-clock concurrency model.

examples.name: CI/CD pipeline
examples.claim: The bounded CI pipeline invokes one outer StepGraph and a nested ForkJoin test stage, crosses the registered identity, dependency, capacity, target-effect, and carrier-handoff seams, and agrees with an independent schedule oracle.
limits: The evidence covers one immutable successful four-job workflow with two required test partitions.
GitHub Actions conformance, failure semantics, caching, deployment correctness, arbitrary graphs, and performance are excluded.

examples.name: Preemptive earliest-deadline-first scheduling
examples.claim: For the registered preemptive uniprocessor task model and bounded cases, the shared-structure construction applies finite processor-demand admission and complete-ready-set earliest-deadline dispatch and agrees with separate admission and exhaustive-scheduling oracles, while the mechanized premise-binding model passes its positive and isolated-control checks.
limits: The Rust differential evidence is bounded to the registered generated grids and named release traces.
The bounded formal model checks composition premises and relies on the cited scheduling theorems for the unbounded implication.
Kernel conformance, multiprocessor behavior, blocking, timing overhead, and performance are excluded.

examples.name: State-based replicated JSON object
examples.claim: For the registered finite JSON-object subset and delivery schedules, the shared-structure construction preserves the state-based merge premises, agrees with separate issued-operation and exact-union references, and converges after complete delivery, while the mechanized premise-binding model passes its positive and isolated-control checks.
limits: Executable evidence is bounded to the named scripts, generated cases, and one finite merge-law state family.
The bounded formal model checks composition premises and relies on the cited CRDT results for the general convergence implication.
Eventual delivery, full JSON behavior, production integration, and performance are excluded.

examples.name: Fixed-grid Renyi differential privacy accountant
examples.claim: For the registered fixed order grid, integer scale, target delta, certified query declarations, and bounded workloads, the shared-structure construction composes every coordinate, selects and enforces the registered reported bound, and agrees with a separate prefix evaluator, while the mechanized premise-binding model passes its positive and isolated-control checks.
limits: The executable workload evidence is bounded to the registered demonstration and generated grid.
The conditional privacy implication and conversion formula rely on the cited source theorem and valid query certificates.
Certificate truth, production mediation, continuous-order optimality, performance, and utility are excluded.

examples.name: Bounded optimistic software transactional memory
examples.claim: For the registered finite word heaps, nonnested transaction declarations, and bounded schedules, the shared-structure construction provides stable-epoch reads, conflict abort, and complete target-bound write publication, and it produces histories accepted by a separate opacity evaluator; the mechanized premise-binding model passes its positive and isolated-control checks.
limits: The exhaustive evidence is bounded to the registered word heaps, transaction programs, and finite schedules.
The construction relies on one standard single-word atomic epoch and makes no general Rust-to-TLA refinement or opacity-proof claim.
Weak memory, crashes, nesting, progress, persistence, production behavior, and performance are excluded.

examples.name: Memoization
examples.claim: Each admitted subproblem is computed once after its dependencies, and its stored result equals the registered predecessor reduction.
limits: The reusable schema has no parametric deductive proof in this artifact.
Instance fidelity is established separately for each registered algorithm.
